entries.title: Design analyzed
entries.message:
This email design reference is a typical password reset notification structured for reusability with defined content blocks.

The layout structure can be mapped as follows:
- Hero block: featuring the affstore logo centered at the top.
- Text block: main heading "Set your new password" followed by explanatory paragraphs and a dynamic URL placeholder.
- CTA block: a prominent button "Set new password" in bright green.
- Text block: a cautionary note for ignoring the email if unrequested.
- Text block: additional support info with an email link.
- Footer block: physical address and terms and conditions link.

There are no visible template family or variant labels in the screenshot. Brand hint is "affstore" as visible in the logo.

Suggested reusable blocks: hero (logo), text (heading and paragraphs), cta (button), footer (address and terms link).

Key asset slots: logo image, button URL, support email link.

Content requirements include:
- Dynamic insertion of affiliate embedded admin domain URL.
- Clear heading and informative paragraphs.
- Clickable CTA button with link.
- Support email link.
- Footer details with address and terms link.

Warnings:
- Ensure all dynamic link placeholders are correctly replaced at send time.
- Confirm that the email link uses safe, valid URLs.
- Accessibility considerations for button colors and text clarity.

Reference family: ""
Reference variant: ""
Brand hint: "affstore"
Section kinds: ["hero", "text", "cta", "text", "text", "footer"]
Suggested blocks: ["hero", "text", "cta", "text", "text", "footer"]
Asset slots: ["logo image", "affiliate embedded admin domain URL", "button URL", "support email"]
Content requirements: ["main heading", "introductory text with dynamic URL", "CTA button text and URL", "cautionary text", "support contact email", "footer address and links"]
Warnings: ["Dynamic URL placeholders must be replaced before sending", "Validate all URLs for safety", "Ensure color contrast and accessibility"]

entries.title: Design analyzed
entries.message: Данный дизайн письма представляет собой структурированную последовательность блоков, удобную для построения из переиспользуемых компонентов шаблона. Основная структура основана на типичной схеме RFM 1-3-3, что подтверждается ярлыком "RFM 1-3-3" в верхней части дизайна. Бренд явно ассоциируется с IQ Option.

entries.title: Design analyzed
entries.message: Сейчас у меня есть только ссылка на приватный Figma frame, самого макета я не вижу. Чтобы собрать письмо по вашей базе, пришли либо open draft/share link на этот frame, либо PNG/JPG export этого frame. Тексты и ссылки можно пока оставить пустыми: сначала соберу структуру, потом добьем локали и картинки.
